Ruhul Amin, j:- This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment dated January 28, 2003 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.4152 of 2000 making the Rule absolute obtained against the judgment and decree dated March 13, 2000 of the Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge) and Artha Rin Adalat, Comilla, in Title Appeal No.101 of 1995 allowing the same and thereupon decreeing the suit upon reversing the judgment and decree dated March 27, 1995 of the Court of Senior Assistant Judge (Laksharn), Sadar, Comilla in Title Suit No.75 of 1994 dismissing the same.
